title: Terragrunt Catalog Entry Schema
description: Schema for a single catalog entry emitted by `terragrunt catalog --format=jsonl`. Each line of output is one entry, and each entry is validated against this schema on its own.

kind.description: What the entry is: an OpenTofu/Terraform module, a boilerplate template, a Terragrunt unit, or a Terragrunt stack.

title.description: Display title, taken from the README front matter or first heading, falling back to the directory name.

description.description: Short description, taken from the README front matter or the text under its headings.

tags.description: Tags declared in the README front matter, in authoring order. Omitted rather than emitted as an empty array when the entry declares none.

source.description: Repository the entry was discovered in, for example `github.com/gruntwork-io/terraform-aws-utilities`. Empty for a repository given as a local path.

dir.description: Slash-separated path of the entry within its repository. Absent when the repository root is itself the entry.

version.description: Latest release tag of the repository. Absent when the repository has no tags.

url.description: Browsable URL of the entry. Absent when one could not be derived from the repository.

component_source.description: Source string to use for the entry, in the form accepted by the `source` attribute of a `terraform` block.

doc.description: README body as written, with front matter removed. Absent when the entry has no README.
